settings.heading: Tech that earns its place on your desk
settings.text:
LuxeTech is the electronics store from Luxe Dealers. We keep a deliberately focused range of everyday tech: the chargers, audio, smart home devices and accessories people actually use every day.

Rather than listing everything a supplier offers, we choose products we'd be happy to use ourselves, and we tell you plainly what's in stock, what it costs and what to expect after you buy.

settings.label: What you can expect from us

settings.title: Honest listings
settings.text: Real stock levels, clear specs and the full price up front.

settings.title: Easy returns
settings.text: Changed your mind? Send unused items back within 30 days.

settings.title: 12-month warranty
settings.text: If something fails from normal use, we'll put it right.

settings.title: People, not bots
settings.text: Questions go to a real person on our team.

settings.heading: Got a question?
settings.text: Whether you're checking compatibility before you buy or need help with an order, we're happy to help.
